selected.name: Cold-light cauldron calibration
selected.idea: An adult witch-artisan calibrates a small black cauldron of luminous potion with a slender wooden wand while seated at a stone laboratory bench. A golden three-ring hourglass pendant sits against a green-and-silver-lined black robe, and a freestanding brass instrument measures the rising steam. Warm skin and cold glow make a quiet close work portrait.

proposals.name: Rain-chamber broom repair
proposals.idea: An adult witch-artisan tests a twig-bristled flying broom after a controlled rain trial. She braces its wooden shaft on a workbench while aiming a slender wooden wand at the binding, wearing a black robe with green-and-silver house lining and a tiny golden nested-ring hourglass pendant. Dry repair tools and damp bristle tips tell the moment.

proposals.name: Orrery workshop timing test
proposals.idea: An adult witch-artisan uses a slender wooden wand to tune the balance of a tabletop brass orrery inside a stone instrument workshop. A twig-bristled broom leans in a timber rack beside the workbench, a golden nested-ring hourglass pendant hangs from her neck, and green-and-silver lining edges her black robe. The moment catches a small repaired mechanism just beginning to turn.
